name: eidola
description: A pixel Vessel that reacts to what Claude is doing, plus an Engram Soul injected into every session.

placement.title: Where the Vessel appears
placement.description: default follows the awake Engram's suggestion (auto if it has none). both: pane and band. pane: pane only. band: band only, and the pane opens only when you ask. auto: band only while no pane is placed.

statusLine.title: Show the Vessel's state in the status line
statusLine.description: The Engram's name and state, such as "Wisp · idle", under the prompt.
